items.text: This update continues from where Chapter Two left off and contains three new maps, six new weapons and a shiny new boss. Simmer's dishes are now all upgradeable, too! We've also revamped a lot of the music from Chapter One.
Hop in and delve into the depths to discover Putrid's true identity!
All the new music from this update and Chapter One can be found in "Dungeon Munchies Original Soundtrack Vol.2"! Now on Steam, Bandcamp, and Spotify!

New features and changes to balance have been released in our Open Beta version. If you'd like to participate in testing these new features, please hop on to the Open Beta and tell us how it goes!
-New Game+
-a New Game+ mode can be played after finishing the game
-Harder enemies and more insight points earned
-Increased mana consumption for flammable breath
-Lowered brightness/sfx volume on Holy Hand Grenade
-Fixed text display issues in the Mac version
-Fixed broken button issue on game quit and early access popups
-Optimized AI for summoned spirits
-Fixed issues with Pesticide effects
-Negative effects of the Pan-Fried Leech Steak now apply to the Holy Hand Grenade
-Fixed incorrect multiplier for Grilled Glowy Shroom
-Fixed Scythe for Interns getting stuck
-Increased the affect time for Macrobiotic Fruit Juice
-Adjusted sound effects and music
-Fixed typos and other assorted bugs
To access the Openbeta：
This patch is mostly adjustments to the game's difficulty based on player feedback we received. Thanks everyone!
1. Reduced knockback. Players shouldn't be knocked off platforms with one drone hit.
2. Adjusted platforms in Steeped City. It should be a friendlier work environment now.
3. Adjusted platforms for Steeped City Boss Final Phase. Friendlier boss fight.
4. Lowered freeze time from ice spikes.
5. Reduced trap/hazard speed in Snow Peak.
6. Fixed apple monster's snowball not disappearing.
7. Reduced damage from Core(Boss) projectiles.
8. Smoothed out difficulty curve for Steeped City & Snow Peak
9. Reduced laser & ice spike damage
10. Removed "This key has been used." message from remapping controls.
1. Our minions will not block enemies' bullets now.
2. Optimize performance in snow maps.

items.text: Translation is finally done and Dungeon Munchies Chapter 2 is now open for English beta testing!
1. Find Dungeon Munchies in Library tab of Steam client.
2. Right-click
3. Hit "Properties"
4. Navigate to "Betas" tab
5. Select "openbeta" in the drop down list .
If you find any bugs or other errors, please leave your comments as a reply to this news post. Thank you!

items.text: Version 0.1.18.2 Changelog
Lowered Slime damage so players aren't getting insta-killed
Improved the sound effects for the Laser Staff
Tweaked slime pool behavior
Fixed some incorrect numbers in weapon descriptions
Fixed some dialogue lines
Watermelons now grow on trees, like they're supposed to.
Some player may be experiencing a bug where the game gets stuck at the nice plastic bag. We're still looking into what's causing the error. Sorry for the inconvenience.
In the meantime, here's something you can do to fix the issue:
Reset and restore default time zones to your computer, or repair any damaged time zone registry files.
Fixed the weapon crafting achievement problem.
Due to enthusiastic player feedback, we now have a long Brachiosaurus-sized to-do list filled with player suggestions and issues to work on.
Over the next few weeks, we'll be clearing up that list so that future apprentices can continue to thrive in a clean, safe and harmonious working environment.
